game.title: The Order: 1886
game.blurb: Cinematic third-person action-adventure set in an alternate-history London, from Ready At Dawn, published by Sony Interactive Entertainment, released 2015-01-13 on PlayStation 4. RAWG average playtime: 11 hours. Genres: Action, Adventure. Chapters are an estimate drawn from the trophy themes RAWG lists.

attribution: Steam: no achievement list available for this game (see notes)
StrategyWiki: no usable walkthrough, nothing used — https://strategywiki.org/wiki/The_Order:_1886

notes: Backlog game, all-AAA pass: picked from RAWG's most-added list for its year across all genres (docs/PLAN.md section 2, genre filter widened 2026-10-23). PlayStation 4 only, so there is no Steam app; RAWG's first result is the expected entry (id 3459). StrategyWiki has a stub page (completion stage 0, marked as a stub): Gameplay, Walkthrough and Table of Contents are linked but not written. theorder1886.fandom.com answers the API under "The Order: 1886" with 13 linked articles; its Chapters category has 18 page names (such as "Once a Knight" and "A Knight No More"), but the category is alphabetical and nothing in the API data gives their order, so the story is one chapter for now. The other chapters come from the 21 trophies RAWG lists (RAWG's percentages, not PlayStation's); RAWG's list has no story trophies, so story ones may be missing from it. Names only were looked at on Fandom, nothing copied.
